output.summary: The 30% ticket revenue drop is mostly explained by the forced move to Brightwater and wider regional decline, not by programming. Single-ticket sales fell 45% in the relocation year. Lapsed patrons cite travel and parking most often. The cathedral, which is close to the rail station, sold far better. Peer orchestras with no venue change fell about 29%. Concerts with and without post-1945 works sell the same at the same venue. Committed subscribers renew at a stable 85%. Marketing effectiveness cannot be assessed without attribution data. Non-renewal or cutting commissions would put the Halvorsen and Arts Council grants at risk. Present a segmented analysis, separate the artistic review from the revenue question, and use the cathedral dates and a shuttle.
